receptor.desc: c-Myc/Max bHLHZip heterodimer (2 copies) from RCSB
receptor.prep: prody protein-only extract; obabel pH7.4 rigid pdbqt

pocket_detection.interpretation: Highest druggability = 0.248 (fpocket). Druggable pockets typically >0.5; MYC/MAX pockets are shallow/low-druggability, consistent with a hard PPI/IDP target.

docking.interpretation: Best Vina = -6.229 kcal/mol into the top shallow pocket — a WEAK/modest score, honestly consistent with low fpocket druggability. Not a strong hit; a starting hypothesis only.

honesty.note: Docking is a secondary geometry metric, not affinity/IC50. Weak score reflects the genuine difficulty of drugging MYC/MAX.
